hints.title: Getting the detections list
hints.content: Call `List<AprilTagDetection> detections = aprilTag.getDetections();` after waitForStart(). You need `import java.util.List;` and `import org.firstinspires.ftc.vision.apriltag.AprilTagDetection;`.

hints.title: Looping through detections
hints.content: Use a for-each loop: `for (AprilTagDetection detection : detections) { ... }`. Inside the loop, access `detection.id` and `detection.ftcPose.range` / `detection.ftcPose.bearing`.

hints.title: Telemetry format
hints.content: Use `telemetry.addData("Tag ID", detection.id)`, `telemetry.addData("Range (in)", "%.1f", detection.ftcPose.range)`, and `telemetry.addData("Bearing (deg)", "%.1f", detection.ftcPose.bearing)` inside the loop. Call `telemetry.update()` once after the loop ends.

hints.title: Where does aprilTag come from?
hints.content: Build it before the VisionPortal: `AprilTagProcessor aprilTag = new AprilTagProcessor.Builder().build();`. The test pre-seeds two detections into it before calling runOpMode().
